context: Asuka explains an academic survey to Ren.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic guidance; vocabulary (電子/受ける/回答/いただく/与える) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 調査は、電子で回答を集めます。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 回答は、誰から受けるんですか?
lines.en: From whom do we receive answers?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 学生から、回答をいただきます。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 謝礼は、与えるんですか?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 回答者には、ささやかな品を与えます。
lines.en: We give respondents a small gift.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 電子で集めると、楽ですね。
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 丁寧な依頼を、受ける側に与えましょう。
lines.en: Let's give respondents a courteous request.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 回答をいただく工夫、考えます。
lines.en: I'll think of ways to receive answers.
lines.style: resolved young student voice, soft warm appreciative throughout
